messages:
Ava: heads-up — new canary (svc-runtime v3.2) started 2m ago in eu-west-1, I'm seeing tail-latency spikes and a handful of 502s from the canary lane. dashboards for svc-runtime/generate are showing empty panels. anyone oncall?
PagerBot: :rotating_light: New incident created: INC-2026-901 — 'canary latency + missing dashboards' — paging #eng-oncall. Severity P2. (link: https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2026-901)
Tom: I'm awake. pulling logs and lb traces. which route did you see the 502s on?
Ava: route=/v1/chat.generate, client=mobile-sdk. 95th latency jumped to ~4.2s (baseline ~220ms). error rate for canary ~6% 502s.
Rashmi: I tried the grafana panel and it errors: "dashboard not found" for svc-runtime/generate. provisioning job looks like it failed around the deploy time.
Luis: frontend traces show downstream grpc errors: "Upstream reset" from the canary instance IPs.
Tom: looking at runtime pod logs — unusual message in the shard manager: `shard_ptr=-1` then a segfault: 
```
2026-02-10T03:15:20Z ERROR shard-manager shard_id=12 shard_ptr=-1
RuntimeError: invalid shard pointer
  File "runtime/core.py", line 438, in process_request
    shard = kv_shards[shard_ptr]
IndexError: list index out of range
```
Rashmi: do we have traffic % for the canary?
Tom: rollout = 3% via rollout-controller. low but enough to surface a bug.
Ava: we should flip the FF to stop the canary. who has permission to flip?
Luis: I can take it. running: `ffctl set svc-runtime.canary false --env=prod --actor=luis --reason="rollback - invalid shard ptr"`
DeployBot: Canary feature flag svc-runtime.canary disabled by luis at 2145679002. Triggering rollback steps.
PagerBot: oncall assigned to Tom.
Tom: muted alert rule `svc_runtime_502s_high` (onsite mute for 20m) to reduce duplicate pages while we mitigate.
Rashmi: SLO panels are blank: the error_budget and error_rate panels show "no data" since 03:14:00Z. Prometheus queries returning empty for the last 10m for route=/v1/chat.generate. Might be a scrape or label-change during deploy.
Ava: that's rough, we need accurate SLO numbers for customer comms. can someone query raw metrics?
Luis: running prom query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/chat.generate",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/chat.generate"}[5m]))` — for the canary subset returning 0.058 (5.8%) when I target pod label `canary=true`. Global query with no canary label returns 0.003 (0.3%).
Tom: SupportBot shows ~9 customer reports in last 12min complaining about slow responses / early failures — ticket ids: #6012 #6013 #6014. Support says some customers saw ~20s wait then a 502.
Rashmi: obs-provisioning team says grafana provisioning job failed due to a templating error during the deploy commit; they're rolling back the provisioning change — ETA ~8-10m.
Ava: ok rollback in flight. post a short status to status page: "Partial degradation for chat generation in eu-west-1. Canary rollout paused and feature flag disabled. Engineers investigating. No region-wide outage." I can send that now.
Tom: go ahead. include that canary traffic was removed.
Ava: posted status.redwood.ai/inc/901 : "Partial degradation in eu-west-1 affecting a subset of traffic for chat generation. Canary rollout paused and disabled. Investigating root cause. Updates to follow."
Luis: DeployBot reports rollback actions completed at 2145679065 — canary traffic removed. backend 502s dropping.
Tom: after the FF flip, 502s trended down to baseline over ~45s. latency returning to normal.
Rashmi: Note: even though metrics are coming back for error rate, the SLO dashboard still shows missing panels until provisioning is fully restored. obs-provisioning says they will validate and then reapply dashboards.
Ava: next steps: 1) triage runtime code -> reproduce pointer underflow. 2) add a unit test for shard pointer validation + guard early fail. 3) add pre-deploy check that the grafana provisioning job is a no-op/failsafe so dashboards don't vanish. 4) consider default canary traffic at 1% for runtime changes.
Tom: I'll take the immediate bug triage and open a PR with a safe-guard.
Rashmi: I'll own follow-up with observability (obs-provisioning) to add a provisioning healthcheck to the deploy playbook and a monitor that alerts when dashboards go missing.
Luis: I'll work with Support to follow up on customer tickets and add a blurb to the incident timeline with impacted customers.
Ava: quick retrospective note — muting the noisy 502 alert helped reduce pager fatigue, but we lost sight because dashboards disappeared. We should have an autopage when key dashboards return "no data" so oncall knows of visibility loss.
Tom: agree. Also recommend adding a canary-health metric (kv_shard_errors or shard_ptr_invalid_count) as a gating signal for rollout-controller.
Ava: thanks team. closing immediate page, incident moved to "mitigated". Postmortem requested and assigned. I'll loop in PM and engineering manager. :white_check_mark:
PagerBot: Incident INC-2026-901 status set to "mitigated". Postmortem requested.
